tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed its first test start, then started after 8 s, ran normally and reached rated pressure; 22.8 V at rest and the partner’s unverified delivery leave firewater protection degraded.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect batteries and starting-air system; correct confirmed defects, then prove first-attempt start and rated discharge pressure. Check and record impairment deviation. Test cranking voltage and starting air. Verify FW-8101 pressure and flow capacity.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Required starting function failed on the first attempt during a function test. The later successful start and rated pressure confirm delivery after starting but not reliable start on demand.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure to start degrades safety-critical firewater protection. FW-8101 is the nominal redundant partner, but its later test showed 9.2 barg versus 11 barg with flow unmeasured, so capable redundancy cannot be credited.

tickets.summary: Main-hoist rope has 6 broken wires per lay versus a 10-wire discard limit at maximum-radius spooling, with poor lubrication; failure could drop the load, while crane loss stops boat offloads.
tickets.recommended_action: Lubricate and inspect the full rope; lifting authority to disposition, then verify wire count and hoist performance. Check loads and personnel exposure. Repeat the full rope survey.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Six broken wires are within the stated ten-wire discard limit, providing margin, but poor lubrication is an active degradation mechanism. No progression history or demonstrated loss of hoisting function is supplied.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Wire-rope failure while hoisting could release the suspended load and create severe personnel or equipment consequences. There is no redundant crane, and crane unavailability prevents supply-boat offloads, causing logistics disruption within days.

tickets.summary: Pump A delivered 9.2 barg versus 11 barg design; flow was unmeasured, so firewater delivery is suspect. Partner B previously failed its first start, and current redundancy is unknown.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect test-line valves and pump condition; obtain fire-protection engineering disposition, correct findings, then retest to approved pressure and flow criteria. Check impairment deviation record. Function-test partner FW-8102. Verify rated firewater delivery.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Below-design running pressure is meaningful degradation, but normal engine parameters, successful starting and absent flow or acceptance data do not establish failed delivery.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure would remove one safety-critical firewater pump. The N+1 partner cannot presently be credited because its recorded test had a failed first start and no current restoration evidence; total unavailability would defeat the stated philosophy and require shutdown.

tickets.summary: Loose, wind-flapping cladding on the second-stage discharge line poses a developing dropped-object hazard, while no process concern is reported.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect attachments, control the drop zone, and securely refit or replace cladding; verify retention after correction. Check personnel exposure below.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The cladding is already loose and moving in wind, with the source predicting it will become a dropped object if left; this is strong progression toward loss of retention.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Detachment presents a credible dropped-object hazard. Personnel exposure and potential injury severity are unknown, while the source explicitly reports no process concern.
